# Orient Medicare

> > Orient Medicare (ORIENTMED) manufactures CE, FDA, and ISO certified medical devices and diagnostic equipment including blood pressure monitors, pulse oximeters, nebulizers, surgical instruments, and infection control products.

Orient Medicare specializes in respiratory care devices (mesh nebulizers, anesthesia masks), vital signs monitoring equipment (blood pressure monitors with oscillometry technology, pulse oximeters), laboratory supplies (centrifugation tubes, agar plates, pipettes), surgical instruments (scalpel blades, cervical spatulas), and infection control solutions (shoe cover dispensers, virus sampling kits). All products meet international standards including CE, FDA, ISO, ESH, and BHS certifications.

## Key Topics

- CE/FDA/ISO Certification
- Blood Pressure Monitors
- Pulse Oximeters
- Mesh Nebulizers
- Oscillometry Technology
- Dual-User Memory
- Virus Sampling Kits
- Infection Control
- Surgical Instruments
- Respiratory Care
- Laboratory Equipment
- IHB Detection
- Medical-Grade Materials (PP, PVC-free, Polyurethane)
- EO Gas Sterilization
- Cleanroom Equipment
